TORONTO


, Nov. 25, 2026


/CNW/ - TD Asset Management Inc. ("TDAM"), the manager of the TD Target Maturity Bond ETFs ("Maturing ETFs"), today announced the final valuation of the Maturing ETFs, which will be terminated today.


As announced on September 11, 2026, the following Maturing ETFs were voluntarily delisted from the Toronto Stock Exchange as of the market close on November 19, 2026, and were terminated effective at the close of business on November 23, 2026. The final net asset value ("NAV") per unit of the Maturing ETFs is as follows:

About TD Asset Management


TD Asset Management (TDAM) is a global asset manager committed to helping clients achieve their investment objectives. We are proud to serve institutional, intermediary and individual investors with solutions designed to address their evolving needs. Our specialized expertise and diverse perspectives enable us to navigate changing markets while pursuing long-term outcomes.


TDAM offers a broad range of investment capabilities across public and private markets: fundamental equity strategies such as free cash flow-driven approaches, quantitative and passive equities; fixed income mandates across the credit quality spectrum; and alternative offerings such as commodities.
